description: This is a PHP source file defining an API endpoint class 'AttendanceEditPunchInRecordOverlapAPI', which provides functionality for checking overlaps when editing punch-in records in the attendance module of OrangeHRM. It includes method implementations for retrieving and validating input parameters, computing UTC times from local times and offsets, and performing overlap checks via attendance data access objects.

classes.name: AttendanceEditPunchInRecordOverlapAPI
classes.description: A PHP class extending Endpoint, implementing resource endpoint interface to handle API requests for checking punch-in record overlaps during editing, with methods for validation, parameter processing, and overlap checking.

methods.description: Handles GET requests to check for punch-in overlap during record editing, retrieves record by ID, verifies access, computes UTC times, and performs overlap verification.
